gd99nqqd.variantName: Walplus 303 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
gd99nqqd.sourceDescription: The Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree brings festive cheer to any home or outdoor space. Designed with simplicity and functionality in mind, it features a clean, minimalist aesthetic while ensuring durability and ease of use. This seasonal décor piece is ideal for adorning living rooms, gardens, and terraces, adding a touch of luxury with lifelike tips and vibrant decorative elements. Its versatile appearance makes it a fitting centerpiece during the holiday season, radiating warmth and celebration spirit. Decorative Elements: This Christmas tree comes beautifully adorned with pine corns and bright red berries that add a festive and natural touch. The thoughtfully placed decorations maintain a harmonious balance, offering a cohesive and stylish holiday theme. These elements also offer visual depth, enhancing the overall appearance whether placed indoors or in a covered outdoor area. Realistic Design: Crafted with lifelike tips, the tree mimics the natural texture of actual foliage, bringing authenticity to its appearance. The detailed design not only makes this tree a focal point of holiday décor but also creates an inviting atmosphere that resembles a real pine, ensuring the seasonal magic comes to life in your home. Easy Setup: Equipped with hinged branches, the tree ensures a straightforward assembly process, saving valuable time and energy during the busy festive season. This intuitive design makes putting up and taking down the tree a hassle-free task, allowing you to easily enjoy the holiday cheer without unnecessary fuss or time-consuming struggles. Stable Base: The tree sits securely on a foldable metal stand, providing excellent stability and support. The durable stand assures it remains in place, preventing wobbling or sagging, thus presenting a neat and organized holiday display. Its foldable feature also allows for practical storage post-holidays, adding to ease of use and convenience. User Instructions: To achieve a fuller and more vibrant tree, users are recommended to allocate 30-45 minutes for shaping its branches. Following the included instructions aids in achieving optimal aesthetics. Additionally, assembling requires two individuals and a screwdriver, accommodating a collaborative holiday setup experience.
